summary: V3 Redesign testing complete. All 37 backend tests passed. All frontend features working: 3-tab navigation (Mission Control, Actions Required, Plan & Commit), Hero Triptych charts on Mission Control (Run End Path, Output Path, Polymer/Fouling Path), Commitment Box with P90/P50 metrics, Priority Actions Preview showing top 3 actions. Actions Required page groups actions by horizon (Now, Next 24h, This week), supports Mark Done with impact banner feedback, and Not Feasible with 5 reason codes. Plan & Commit page has 4 scenario cards (Baseline, Proactive, Run Rescue, Custom) with comparison view and intervention timeline. Day selector with quick chips (7, 30, 52, 70, 96, 110) works across all pages. Default Day 70 confirmed.
